Old-Fashioned Hot Chocolate
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 25, 2009 - 12:09am

Ingredients




3 ounces Unsweetened Chocolate
1/2 cup Sugar
1 dsh Salt
1 cup Water
3 cups Milk

Preparation

1 Combine chocolate, sugar, salt, and water in a medium-size saucepan. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, 5 minutes, or until chocolate is melted. Stir in milk slowly; heat until just piping hot. Beat with a rotary beater until foamy-topped.
